sloka: तस्मिन्नाहूयमाने ऽस्त्रे हूयमाने च पावके।सार्धं ग्रहेन्दुनक्षत्रैर्वितत्रास नभःस्थलम् ।। ६.७३.२४ ।।
transliteration: tasminnāhūyamāne 'stre hūyamāne ca pāvake।sārdhaṁ grahendunakṣatrairvitatrāsa nabhaḥsthalam ।। 6.73.24 ।।

translations.english: There he strewed into the fire, lances as leaves, dark coloured live go at clasped by its neck and consigned.
